FLASHCARD · COLORS & SHAPES · AGES 2 YEARS

Rectangle Flashcard for Toddlers

A square stretched long — four sides, two short and two long. Doors, tables, books and screens are all rectangles, which quietly makes this the most-seen shape of the whole day.

Say it together

“A rectangle has long sides. Can you find one?”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the word, the sound, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

Compare it to the square card side by side: "short-short-long-long." Then find the door and trace its rectangle frame. Doors are the giant rectangle your toddler touches daily.

Quick parent note

Rectangle is a mouthful. Say "long square" as a friendly shortcut for now — the real word grows in when the mouth is ready.
